title: Agent rollout
intro: Two-step: upload a binary, then flip target_version on one scope.

upload.title: 1. Upload a binary
upload.description: POSTs to /api/agents/publish (64 MB body limit). The Object Store key is auto-extracted from the binary's embedded VERSIONINFO resource — no label to type, no chance of a label/binary mismatch. CLI: kanade agent publish <binary>.

rolloutPanel.title: 2. Roll out a version
rolloutPanel.description: Or click Roll out on a row in the table below to pre-fill the form.

health.title: Adoption: {{version}}
health.description: How the fleet has taken up the selected target version. Quarantined hosts crash-looped on it and rolled back — a sign the rollout is bad.
health.quarantinedHint: rolled back after a failed boot

releases.title: Object Store releases
releases.description: From /api/agents/releases. Click Roll out to point the form above at a row; Delete removes the binary from the Object Store (refused with 409 if any scope still targets it).
releases.empty: Object Store empty — upload a binary above (or run kanade agent publish <binary>).
releases.confirmDelete: Delete release {{version}}? This cannot be undone.
